chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who commits zina while he has not consummated marriage with his wife: does he become muḥṣan? He said: “No, nor through a slave-girl.”

key_terms.أَيُحْصَنُ: does he attain the status of being muḥṣan

ai.seo_question: Does a man become muḥṣan for zina rulings before consummating marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning iḥṣān in the law of zina. It indicates that a man is not considered muḥṣan merely by having a wife unless he has consummated the marriage, and that this status is also not established through a slave-girl.
